data.body: 67aa plan-review round 3: BLOCK (1 blocker + 2 advisories). B1 [G6]: $250 cap enforced only vs pre-flight estimates via reserve(); finalize() prices ACTUAL usage and cumulative actual spend never re-checked -> a per-criterion actual over its estimate can push total past 250 undetected. FIX: after EACH finalize, re-read cumulative actual spend from ledger; if >= cap_usd, halt FATALLY before any further criterion (added AC#4 + Budget/Failure prose). A2 [G6]: strict validation also requires non-empty gold_set + >=1 deterministic gating scorer, not just balanced dataset. FIX: runner carries candidate's strict-only fields (prompt/model/epochs/gate/coverage_threshold/scorers) UNCHANGED and rebuilds dataset+gold_set from reproducing cases; withhold if filtered gold_set/dataset empty or unbalanced. Desc 7963 chars, 11 ACs (9 codebase + 2 non-codebase). Round 4 running.
